shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git ls-files | head -50 && head -c 600 package-lock.json
for f in index.html src/* tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -15; npm ls @gravity-ui/uikit sass 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head; grep -n '"sass\|"dependencies"' -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -40

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/styles/ | head; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -120; grep -n '"exports"' -A25 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -40; grep -rn "Checkbox\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -3
U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; sed -n 80,200p $U/README.md; cat $U/docs/theming.md | head -80; ls $U/styles; ls $U/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs; ls $D | head -5; ls $D/* 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "textinput|checkbox|card|flex|provider|text\b|password" | head -20; sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs; ls $D/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat $D/components/PasswordInput.md | head -80; cat $D/components/Card.md | head -50; cat $D/components/Checkbox.md | head -40

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build; ls $D/docs/components/controls; cat $D/docs/components/controls/PasswordInput.md 2>/dev/null | head -60; cat $D/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "Provider\|theme" $D/docs/guides/theming.md 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls $D/docs/guides

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build; sed -n 1,40p $D/docs/guides/i18n.md; grep -n "gap\|direction\|space" $D/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; grep -n "variant\|color" $D/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head
sed -i 's/gap={5}/gap="spacing-5"/' src/LoginPage.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
rm -rf dist && which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>&1 | head -3; git status --short
